endangerment.comment: Arabic, Gulf (afb-afb) = 3 (Wider communication). De facto national working language, widely used in public administration. Originated from the speakers of Najdi Arabic who migrated to Kuwait in the 18th century; emerged as a mixture of various different dialects. Became widely spoken around 1914. Widespread in the Arabian Gulf region. Used in everyday life, in media, and in business. Influenced by Persian [pes], Hindi [hin], Turkish [tur], Portuguese [por], English [eng], and other languages are evident due to historical trade and cultural exchanges. It is used in daily communication, media, and informal settings.
